name: Ринг · fable50 · Главбух Зоя Павловна
description: A native Russian woman in her early sixties, a formidable Soviet-era chief accountant. Low, firm contralto, slightly husky, dry and unhurried, with steel underneath and a note of weary irony. Flat deadpan bureaucratic delivery: she never shouts, she pronounces verdicts. Clear standard Moscow Russian, crisp consonants, measured pace, authoritative and intimidating in a calm office way. Close studio microphone, clean recording.
